description:
Documentation gaps/inconsistencies found while reviewing the concurrency
surface. These are low-severity on their own but compound user confusion about
a feature that (per the sibling TODOs) already behaves unexpectedly.

- `--streams` is documented in docs/usage/faq.md and docs/concepts/workflow.md
  but is ABSENT from the canonical CLI reference docs/reference/cli/run.md.
  (Note: throughput-stream-count-wiring-defect must land first, since today
  --streams is effectively ignored -- do not document it as working until it
  does.)
- Config default mismatch: docs/reference/cli/configuration.md documents
  `execution.concurrent_queries.max_concurrent` default = 2, while
  docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md shows an example with
  max_concurrent = 4. Reconcile to the real default.
- docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md references
  `_project/TPC_SPECIFICATION_COMPLIANCE.md`, which does not exist. Fix or
  remove the dangling link.
- Ensure the documented DuckDB single-connection/per-cursor caveat and the
  TPC-H(0.99)/TPC-DS(0.70) success-gate divergence stay in sync with whatever
  the code changes in the sibling TODOs settle on.

preserves.behavior: Existing accurate caveats (DuckDB cursor sharing, success-gate divergence) remain documented.

prior_art.concept: docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md — the guide with the 4-vs-2 example and the dangling link.
docs/benchmarks/tpc-h.md / tpc-ds.md — where the DuckDB and permutation caveats live.
docs/reference/cli/configuration.md — the max_concurrent default of record.

verifications.description: Docs link-check passes and no dangling internal references remain

work_units.notes:
Verified the real default in code: benchbox/utils/config_helpers.py:78
and benchbox/cli/config.py:50/280 all default
execution.concurrent_queries.max_concurrent to 2, matching
docs/reference/cli/configuration.md:297 (already correct). The
mismatch was entirely in
docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md's illustrative YAML
example, which showed max_concurrent: 4 with nothing marking it as a
non-default example. Added an explicit callout above the block
("illustrative example, not the shipped defaults") linking to
Configuration reference -> `execution`, plus inline "(default: N)"
comments on every field in that YAML block. Python-code examples
further down that pass max_concurrent=4/level as explicit function
arguments were left as-is -- self-evidently overrides, not claimed
defaults.
work_units.summary: Reconcile max_concurrent default across configuration.md and the guide

work_units.notes:
That file never existed in docs/ or _project/. Replaced the dangling
reference in docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md with links
to the docs that actually cover TPC compliance/permutations:
docs/guides/tpc/tpc-h-official-guide.md#tpc-h-specification-compliance,
docs/guides/tpc/tpc-ds-official-guide.md, and the shared
docs/guides/tpc/tpc-patterns-usage.md. All three targets confirmed to
exist; scripts/check_doc_relative_links.py baseline unchanged (43, no
new broken links) after the edit.

throughput-stream-count-wiring-defect (sibling #1) is merged to
develop. Verified the actual CLI surface directly (`benchbox run
--help-topic all` and `benchbox run-official --help`): plain `run`
(including `run --official`) has NO `--streams`/`--concurrency`
option at all -- confirmed live: `benchbox run --platform duckdb
--benchmark tpch --scale 1 --phases throughput --streams 4` errors
with "Error: No such option: --streams". Only the deprecated
`run-official` command exposes `--streams INTEGER` (required when
--phases includes throughput). Since docs/reference/cli/run.md is
exclusively the `run` command's reference, documenting --streams as
a `run` option would itself be inaccurate. Added a note under the
`throughput` phase bullet stating plain `run` has no such flag, plus
a full "Deprecated: `run-official`" section documenting its real
option list (including --streams) accurately.

Extended fix (same "don't document --streams as working where it
isn't" goal, and directly named in this TODO's own description):
docs/usage/faq.md documented `benchbox run ... --streams 4` (the
non-official command) as working -- verified it errors identically.
Fixed to the working `run-official ... --streams 4` form.
docs/concepts/workflow.md's compliance-workflow example used
`run-official ... --test-type power/throughput`, but `--test-type`
is not a real run-official option (the real option is --phases) --
verified against run_official.py's click options and a live
`run-official tpch --platform duckdb --scale 1 --phases power --seed
42 --output <tmp>` invocation (parsed and executed with no "no such
option" error). Fixed to --phases; both files now cross-link the new
CLI reference section.
work_units.summary: Document --streams in run.md once throughput-stream-count-wiring-defect lands

first checking whether those TODOs already reconciled the caveats.
work_units.summary: Keep the DuckDB single-connection/success-gate divergence caveats in sync with sibling TODOs
